mapper.insert: insert into scMoAnnoTask(task_name, start_time, uploader_id, details, type, parameters, model_id, re_pretrain) values(#{taskName}, #{startTime}, #{uploaderId}, #{details}, #{type}, #{parameters}, #{modelId}, #{rePretrain} )
mapper.delete: delete scmoannotask from scmoannotask where task_id = #{id}
delete scmoannotask from scmoannotask where task_name = #{taskName}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scmoannotask t JOIN models m ON t.model_id = m.model_id WHERE t.uploader_id = #{id};
SELECT * FROM scMoAnnoUser u JOIN scMoAnnoTask t ON u.user_id = t.uploader_id JOIN models m ON t.model_id = m.model_id;
SELECT u.user_name FROM scMoAnnoTask t JOIN scMoAnnoUser u ON t.uploader_id = u.user_id WHERE t.task_name = #{taskName};
SELECT t.* FROM share s JOIN scMoAnnoTask t ON s.task_id = t.task_id WHERE s.share_id = #{shareId};
